tweets.title: R to @NetramDefence: 1931: The Swaraj Flag The year 1931 was a landmark in the history of the flag. A resolution was passed adopting a tricolor flag as the official flag of the Indian National Congress. Design: It featured three horizontal stripes of Saffron (top), White (middle), and Green (bottom). Symbols: Mahatma Gandhi's spinning wheel (Charkha) was placed in the center of the white stripe. The colors were officially interpreted as having no communal significance, saffron stood for courage and sacrifice, white for peace and truth, and green for faith and chivalry. 5/6
tweets.content:
1931: The Swaraj Flag

The year 1931 was a landmark in the history of the flag. A resolution was passed adopting a tricolor flag as the official flag of the Indian National Congress.

Design: It featured three horizontal stripes of Saffron (top), White (middle), and Green (bottom).

Symbols: Mahatma Gandhi's spinning wheel (Charkha) was placed in the center of the white stripe. The colors were officially interpreted as having no communal significance, saffron stood for courage and sacrifice, white for peace and truth, and green for faith and chivalry.

5/6

Required Image Characteristics
- Format: orthorectified GeoTIFF or COG.

- Off-nadir angle: ideally <= 30°.
- Coverage: apron, shelters, taxiways, and parked aircraft, not a tightly cropped single aircraft.

- Aircraft: preferably at least 5 clearly visible aircraft.
